app.name: Ardea
app.tagline: Understand the risk. Know what matters. Act immediately.

overview.emptyText: Once sources are synced and a project describes what it runs, open actions and their deadlines appear here.

actions.emptyText: An action appears when a vulnerability affects a component of one of your projects.

projects.emptyText: A project describes what you run, so Ardea can tell which vulnerabilities affect it.

sources.emptyText: Each source shows here when it last synced and whether it is healthy.

rules.emptyText: Rules decide who hears about which actions, by email, push or webhook.

team.emptyText: Members, their roles and open invitations appear here.

settings.emptyText: The organization, its deadlines and its AI data policy will be set here.
